messages:
Rosa (Finance): Quick follow-up from the AH finance segment — using this thread for concrete questions about runway assumptions, spend approvals, and procurement fast-track.
Ken (Product): Two quick ones: what runway should product teams plan against for new feature bets? And any exceptions for customer-facing experiments?
Rosa (Finance): Plan against the conservative runway of 10 months for planning (assumes hiring slowdown + 10% ARR downside). Customer experiments that can materially move revenue may use the discretionary pool (see below).
Amira (Eng): If a team wants to prepay for a 2-month Dedicated reserve to secure pricing, how is that reflected in team budgets vs company runway?
Rosa (Finance): Cash impact hits company runway immediately. For team-level reporting we will pro-rate the cost across the covered months so team monthly dashboards show smoothed spend.
Zoe (FP&A): Action: I'll upload a simple pro-forma that shows both cash hit and pro-rated view into #all-hands-followups by EOD.
Ken (Product): Discretionary pool details? Who can tap it and what's the approval cadence?
Rosa (Finance): $45k/month discretionary pool for revenue experiments and product pilots. Requires 2-line rationale + manager + finance lead signoff. Retro approvals under $5k allowed with post-hoc reporting.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: hiring pause memo available in #people-ops. Exceptions require VP approval.
Amira (Eng): Emergency infra overages: what's the fastest path to avoid incident-causing throttles?
Rosa (Finance): Emergency path: post in #spend-approvals with "EMERGENCY" tag and ping finance. We can approve up to $20k temporarily with a 48h mitigation plan; >$20k needs VP review.
Ken (Product): Any SLAs for Legal/Procurement on sales-critical vendors? We lost time before due to legal backlog.
Rosa (Finance): There's a fast-track lane for time-sensitive vendors — use the vendor fast-track form in the vendor portal and mark as "time-sensitive". Legal aims for 48-72h initial review for fast-track.
Sam (CEO): High-level: keep experiments moving but prioritize runway. Finance — post a one-pager with the discretionary pool rules, emergency spend path, and vendor fast-track instructions by tomorrow morning.
Rosa (Finance): Will post to #all-hands-followups and pin. Zoe will attach the pro-forma.
Zoe (FP&A): Pro-forma and a short FAQ will be up by 10:00 PST tomorrow.
Ken (Product): Thanks, very helpful.
Amira (Eng): Thanks all.
Rosa (Finance): Keep questions coming here and we'll update the FAQ.
